verdicts.evidence: lines 792-950: every button (Save note, Move to another day, Move job, Cancel, Undo move, Complete job, dialog buttons, three Try again, Clear search/Check again) has a listener that calls the api or changes the view as labelled
lines 557-567, 691-704, 730-735: all rows, facts, notes and the count (line 591) come from api.listJobs/getJob results; no hardcoded sample values or placeholder text in the markup
line 896: confirm dialog title names the job ref and customer; move form (345-358) sits under the When/Work/Address facts on the same view
lines 526-528, 789: note draft written to localStorage on every input; line 777 restores it on return or reload; lines 806-815 clear it only on success, so a failed save keeps the text
lines 390, 899: dialog focus starts on 'Not yet', so Enter does not complete; line 829 preselects the next day in the move form, which is only sent by pressing Move job
lines 284-312: the list view shows the day's jobs sorted by slot (507, 624) with a live search field on the same screen (941); no extra screen needed to see or find a job

lines 284-380: list, search, job facts, notes, add note, move, complete all map to the brief; day links (290-294) support seeing a moved job; job count line 591 is the result count; no stat cards, feeds or tips
lines 343-356, 375: job view has one btn-primary (Complete job), the rest plain .btn; dialog (389-390) has one btn-primary; list view buttons are all plain

lines 343 and 389: the irreversible action is the btn-primary button both on the job view ('Complete job') and in the dialog ('Complete and send invoice'); focus is on 'Not yet' (899) but the action is still the primary-styled button
lines 658-662, 718-721: buttons get aria-disabled only while a request is in flight, with a busy label; line 713 removes the actions block when the job is complete instead of greying it
no title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script
lines 278-392 and all strings in 577-916: visible text is headings, labels, statuses and errors about jobs; nothing mentions the build, the stack, the brief or simulated data
line 353 (shown only for a job booked today, line 717) sits above the Move job button; line 386 warning sits in the completion dialog; line 348 is a format hint; no other notices
lines 286-376: no sentence narrates the screen or its controls; prose is limited to a field label (297), a one-line hint (348) and decision warnings (353, 386)
lines 286-287, 641: subtitle under 'Today's jobs' is the calendar date, not a restatement; hint 'Tomorrow or later' (348) adds the rule to label 'New date'; no helper text repeats its label
all strings (lines 286-390, 577-916): no greetings, slogans, exclamation marks or promotional words; headings are 'Today's jobs', 'Notes', the customer name

line 390: dialog safe button is labelled 'Not yet', which does not start with a verb or name the outcome; other labels (Save note, Move job, Complete and send invoice, Clear search, Undo move) are specific verbs

lines 564, 697: status enum is shown as 'Complete' or 'Booked'; rows show the HH- job number, not the job_ id (563); dates shown as 'Today', 'Mon 16 Nov' (470); error codes are mapped to sentences (812-814, 861-863)

lines 483, 577, 593, 683-684, 814, 863, 916: messages such as 'Could not load today's jobs. Check your signal and try again.' name the problem and next step; the server's ECONNRESET text is never displayed
lines 577-916: error strings use 'Could not load', 'Note not saved', 'Choose tomorrow or later'; no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals
line 581: empty day shows 'No jobs booked for today.' with a 'Check again' button; line 740: 'No notes yet.' directly above the Add a note form; line 586: no-match line with 'Clear search'
lines 577-587: load failure shows a role=alert message with Try again; no jobs shows 'No jobs booked for...' with Check again; unmatched search shows 'No jobs for today match "q"' with Clear search

lines 577, 593, 599: list failure stated in place with Try again, stale rows kept; 684-686, 738-745 job and notes retry; 810-815 note text kept with error; 863-867 move form stays open; 916-920 dialog stays open with error

lines 578, 611: 'Loading jobs...' plus skeleton rows at once; 597 'Updating...'; 681 'Loading job...'; 738 'Loading notes...'; 718-720, 750 busy labels on buttons; reads retry at most 3 times (487-491), about 4.5s worst case

lines 576-578: with no cached entry the view shows 'Loading jobs...' and skeletons, and the empty text and count are only built once an entry exists (580-592); notes show 'Loading notes...' not 'No notes yet.' until loaded (738-740)

lines 89, 178, 210, 230, 244: overflow-wrap anywhere on titles, row cells, facts, notes and dialog title; grid uses minmax(0,1fr) (170, 253); notes absent from list rows handled (725). Phone is assumed present (704) but the server always supplies it
lines 787-789: the unsaved note is stored per job on every keystroke; line 777 puts it back when the job is reopened, so leaving the view does not discard it
lines 347-349: 'Tomorrow or later' hint is under the 'New date' label before any input, and line 828 sets the date input's min to tomorrow
lines 345-358, 371-376, 296-299: each form has a single field (date, note, search); no form mixes required and optional fields
lines 797-801, 851-853: checks run only in the submit handlers; input handlers (787-791, 834-838) only clear an existing error and never raise one
lines 351, 374: error paragraphs sit directly under their fields; lines 749, 842 set aria-invalid, which gives a thicker border (125) alongside the bold text message
lines 806-815: the textarea is cleared only after addNote succeeds; lines 863-867: on a failed move the form stays open with the chosen date still in the input

lines 798-800: empty note sets the error and focuses the textarea; 840-844 moveError focuses the date input; aria-invalid set (749, 842) and aria-describedby points to the error paragraphs (349, 373), which are role=alert

lines 355, 375: submit buttons have no disabled attribute; pressing with missing input shows 'Write a note before saving.' (798) or 'Choose a date.' (851); aria-disabled only while in flight (718, 750)
lines 795, 849, 873, 905: each handler returns early if its busy set already holds the job id; buttons show 'Saving note...', 'Moving job...', 'Undoing...', 'Completing...' until the response

lines 804-805, 854-855, 875-876, 906-908: busy state is rendered synchronously before the await; 620-621 retry and Check again switch at once to 'Loading jobs...' or 'Updating...'; 757-758 same for the job view

lines 807-809: saved note appears in the list and the field clears; 859 'Moved to tomorrow.' and When updates; 912 completion message and Complete badge; every catch branch sets a visible message (811-814, 861-863, 881-882, 916)

line 859: 'Moved to tomorrow.' shows beside the When field that already shows the new day, though it also carries Undo when one is possible; line 912 reports the unseen invoice email. Two readings gave different verdicts
lines 308, 321, 351, 366, 374, 387: errors render in place in fixed elements; no setTimeout dismissal exists; the Undo message stays until the user leaves the job (958)

lines 846-859: moving a job runs with no confirmation and sets undoTo when the original day is still in the future; lines 339, 871-887 'Undo move' moves it back. Moves from today cannot be reversed by the server and get a warning (353)

lines 892-899: Complete opens a dialog titled 'Complete HH-5122 for <customer>?' with 'The customer will be emailed an invoice straight away. This cannot be undone.' (386), buttons 'Complete and send invoice' and 'Not yet', focus on 'Not yet'
lines 384-392, 892-899: the only dialog in the file guards completing a job, which is irreversible and emails an invoice; notes, moves, search and retries have no confirmation
lines 807, 858, 878, 911: every change is applied with applyJob only after the awaited api call resolves; nothing is updated ahead of the server
lines 384-392: the only modal holds one decision with two buttons and opens only from the Complete job button (892-898); the move form and note form are inline on the page

lines 898-899: native dialog opened with showModal and focus placed on 'Not yet'; Escape closes it except mid-request (902); native close returns focus to the trigger, and after completion focus goes to the title (925); visible 'Not yet' button
lines 284-312: list view is heading, day links, search, then the job list; lines 316-376: job view is the customer heading and facts first, then actions, then notes
lines 278-287: a one-line header link then the heading 'Today's jobs' and the list; no hero, greeting or introductory panel
line 591: the only summary is 'N jobs, M complete' above the list, which tells the engineer how much of the day is left and doubles as the result count; no cards or charts
lines 583-587, 600-602: with a search active the status line reads '3 of 9 jobs match "quay"' directly above the rows with a 'Clear search' button beside it
lines 279-390, 559-560: every control is a native a, button, input, textarea or dialog; busy buttons use aria-disabled so stay focusable (661); search submit moves focus to the first result (942-946)
lines 484, 564, 697: Complete status has a check icon and the word 'Complete'; errors have text plus a thicker border (125); the current day link has an underline bar and aria-current (140, 645)

lines 302, 304, 319, 338, 364, 394: role=status elements present in the initial markup for list status, updating, job load, job message, notes and announcements; lines 308, 321, 351, 366, 374, 387 are role=alert for errors
line 344: move toggle is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; line 715 updates aria-expanded each render to match moveOpen

lines 168-185: job rows are a 3-column grid that stacks work and address under the name on phones; 248-250 buttons go full width below 30rem; 238 dialog is 100% minus 32px; 132 day links wrap; no fixed widths over 375px
lines 140, 645: in the Days navigation the Today link gets aria-current=page with an inset underline bar and a text colour change when today is shown; the heading names the day in view (638)
lines 531-543: hash routes #/, #/day/DATE and #/job/ID with ?q= for the search; line 937 writes the search into the URL as it is typed; parseRoute on load (973) restores day, job and search

lines 953-965: hashchange drives views; 955 stores scroll per view and 653 restores it when coming back from a job; the search survives in the hash (937); 957 closes an open dialog on navigation and nothing reopens it

lines 279, 316: header link on every view and a back link to the day list on the job view, including its not-found and load-error states (683-688); list states offer Try again, Check again or Clear search
line 384: native dialog element with aria-labelledby=cd-title and aria-describedby, opened with showModal (898)
no stepped flow; note, move and complete are each a single inline form or one dialog

lines 95, 109: buttons min-height 48px, small buttons 44px; 135 day links 44px; 82 brand link 48px; 204 back link 44px; 212 phone link 44px; job rows are full-width links with 12px padding over three lines (168-173)
